narrative.northStar: The Study Desk and the Lab Notebook
narrative.overview: A quiet desk where a student does ordered work. Paper-coloured pages hold white panels with thin borders, laid out like notebook entries: a heading, a short explanation, a formula, a test. Nothing competes with the lesson.
keyCharacteristics: Flat panels on a tinted page, separated by 1px lines.
One sans family; a serif only for lesson reading.
44px minimum touch targets, 64px for test answers.

rules.name: The Token Only Rule
rules.body: No colour literal outside tokens.css and Avatar.jsx.

rules.name: The Soft Wrong Rule
rules.body: Wrong answers use amber, never error red.

rules.name: The Accent Is Action Rule
rules.body: Accent marks what can be pressed, what is selected, and progress.

rules.name: The Control Line Rule
rules.body: Panels get the faint line. Anything interactive gets the control line.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Do not add a second sans family. The serif is for long lesson reading only.

rules.name: The Flat Until Floating Rule
rules.body: Panels never carry a shadow. Only things that float above the page do.

dos: Do use the tokens in tokens.css for every colour.
Do make sure every var(--name) you write exists.
Do give each screen one primary action.
Do keep text at 4.5:1 and controls at 3:1.
donts: Don't use --surface as text on a filled accent; use --on-accent.
Don't use error red for a wrong answer.
Don't add a second sans font family.
